name: Clean
viewport_condition: Clean viewport. Visibility may still be affected by water, particles, or lighting.
cleaning_interpretation: No cleaning is indicated by the image alone.

name: Light
viewport_condition: Light local deposits, with the view still largely usable.
cleaning_interpretation: Cleaning is not urgent; continue monitoring.

name: Moderate
viewport_condition: Clear deposits affecting part of the field of view.
cleaning_interpretation: Inspect or clean if the condition persists or conflicts with the monitoring task.

name: Severe
viewport_condition: Severe deposits or smearing that interfere with routine interpretation.
cleaning_interpretation: Cleaning is recommended before routine image-based monitoring continues.

name: Heavy
viewport_condition: Heavy obstruction or blur that strongly compromises scene interpretation.
cleaning_interpretation: Cleaning is required before treating the image stream as reliable.
